title: MCT4-Associated Lactate Export Defines Myeloid Metabolic Reprogramming during Head and Neck Cancer Progression.
publicationName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
journalName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
snippet: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) development is accompanied by metabolic remodeling of the tumor microenvironment, yet how metabolic programs evolve across specific cell populations during tumor progression remains poorly understood. We integrated single-cell RNA-sequencing data from five HNSCC cohorts comprising 645,351 cells from 114 patients...
